milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate to and visually observe the potted dead bush inside the sandstone shelter. The potted dead bush is at spawn-relative (5, 1, 7). max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to clearly see it (inside or at the entrance of the building), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking toward it, confirming visual identification rather than just passing nearby.
